mapper.select: WITH existing AS ( SELECT o.uuid FROM organizations o JOIN workspaces w ON w.organization_uuid = o.uuid WHERE w.external_id = #{workspaceExternalID} LIMIT 1 ), updated AS ( UPDATE organizations o SET name = #{name}, updated_at = NOW() FROM existing WHERE o.uuid = existing.uuid RETURNING o.uuid ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO organizations (name) SELECT #{name} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing) RETURNING uuid ) SELECT uuid FROM updated UNION ALL SELECT uuid FROM inserted LIMIT 1
